label: inspect-largest-unpublished-files
command: import subprocess,pathlib; names=subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard"],text=True).splitlines(); sizes=sorted([(pathlib.Path(n).stat().st_size,n) for n in names],reverse=True); print("\n".join(str(s)+" "+n for s,n in sizes[:15])); print("total",sum(s for s,n in sizes))
